basic_profile.bio: I'm a 26-year-old music enthusiast living in the suburbs of London. By day, I work as a junior marketing associate at a tech startup. In my free time, I love exploring different genres of music, playing the piano, and going for long nature walks. I'm also starting to get into fitness and have a newfound interest in fly fishing. I'm single and usually browse Reddit during my daily commute or late in the evening.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of classical music, mostly self-taught through online resources and community recommendations. I began learning the piano in high school and recently rekindled my passion for it. I’m also exploring the music industry to understand more about its dynamics and trends.
